'''Roegr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who [[Second Battle of Roche|fought]] at [[Nickel One]] alongside [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], [[Mirta Gev]] and [[Vatok Tawr]]. He held a great dislike&mdash;if not hatred&mdash;for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. During the infiltration of Nickel One, his brother [[Death/Legends|died]] aboard a [[Tra'kad-class transport|''Tra'kad'']] that had been hit with several mines during a run against the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. After the attempt to kill off the entire [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]] failed due to [[Darth Caedus]]'s rescue, Roegr made an attempt to kill Caedus in one-on-one combat only to have Caedus shatter his [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armor]] by using the presumed-lost art of [[Shatterpoint/Legends|shatterpoints]]. He was then [[Shiak|impaled]] through the chest by Caedus's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
